caps_finalize_instruction: Wait until both earlier phases are terminal; set calls=900-actual earlier sent calls, total_usd=5-earlier receipts-0.0012855 reconciliation; set new_send_seconds=min(2700,floor(absolute deadline minus current UTC)-30)>0. Freeze final candidate, regenerate transport receipt, freeze all new files and final earlier calls/cost summaries. No paid sends while draft.
comparison_note: Baseline receipt binds this round immediate pre-fix working tree, not the older semantic-baseline. Both arms use identical preserved source evidence, requirements, model policy and ontology. Request/control schemas may differ as part of the repair; shared transport implementation and its final config/AST contract dependencies must pass a separate comparability check.

stability_policy.baseline_reference: Earlier baseline trials retained as separately phased historical comparison; no baseline job is rerun here.
stability_policy.branch_labels: Same frozen Companies current/history-companion, BN current registration and SOR transparent types as preceding evaluation.
stability_policy.no_misfill_scope: Wrong values measured only within frozen positive opportunities; unsupported emissions only within frozen abstention opportunities; other emissions remain unscored.
stability_policy.target_history: Distinguish never proposed, proposed then absent from final, probe-informative then absent, and retained; proposed does not imply supported.

unknown_outcome_policy: Stop new requests globally; never resend unknown outcome.
